description_text:
Telecommunications Tower environment asset. Real world scale (around 20 meters tall). Photo-realistic asset with 4K RGB packed PBR texture maps.
Mostly quads topology with 4,707 faces and 5,438 verts. When converted to tris, the total tri count is 8,934). Clean mesh with no shading errors, n-gons, co-planar faces, or isolated vertices.The UV space is cleverly constructed using overlapping UVs to maximise efficiency. Even though the tower is quite large, even 2K map resolution looks relatively good. However, 4K textures are included for close up renders.
The interchange formats were tested.
Unreal Engine file is ready to use in any project and has materials, real world scale, collision (automatically generated complex as simple) and automatically generated lightmap UVs.
Please set Maya units to Meter. The file should have relative filepaths.

description_text:
A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea, or on a lake or river. Many different kinds of vessels are used in commercial, artisanal and recreational fishing.
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.[2][1]
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

description_text:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of a futuristic building, ideal for your scenes/concepts. Ideal for futuristic city skylines but also detailed enough for closer shots. This model is based on my own concept, it's modeled in 3dsmax. It's simple to arrange it in different scale and composition.
IMPORTANT NOTICE - 3dsmax is native software for this model. You can use it in any other 3D software as well, but you'll need to create shaders/materials with provided textures. Materials I created are fairly simple and I didn't use many textures at all, mostly procedural shaders and colors. There is a marmoset preview for you to inspect the geometry.
Downloadable content:

  - NATIVE 3dsmax files (versions 2023 and 2020) - Corona material-ready

  - FBX file

  - OBJ file

  - Blender scene (imported mesh only, shaders must be created manually)

  - Textures

If you have any questions, feel free to ask.

description_text:
Subway Traffic Light in Game Ready. A set of traffic lights for use in the subway. There are several options for floor-mounted traffic lights with boxes and several wall-mounted options for installation on subway tunnel tubes. All variants of Emissive textures are available for any combination of traffic light colors. Perfect for the Unreal Engine & Unity.
Features:

  - Hight Quality Model & Materials

  - PBR Materials

  - Reasonable poly count

  - Optimized the density of the textures

  - Several color options for emissive textures

  - Maps Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic are collected in ORM packages

Technical details
Available file formats:

  - Blender Scene (Native)

  - Unity 2022 [Built-in | URP | HDRP]

  - FBX

  - OBJ & MTL

  - STL

  - USDC

  - PNG for Textures

3D Specification:

  - 8 Unique Mesh

  - 8 Materials

  - 10 Textures 4096x4096 

  - Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM Pack (Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic), Emissive

Textures ZIP file:

  - 13 Textures 4096x4096

  - Maps: BaseColor, Normal, Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic, ORM Pack, Emissive

Range of Tris:

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_visor - 23428 Tris / 13025 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light - 22198 Tris / 12221 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_visor - 19552 Tris / 10932 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB - 18732 Tris / 10396 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_for_wall_visor - 14068 Tris / 7635  Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_for_wall - 12838 Tris / 6831 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_for_wall_visor - 10192 Tris / 5554 Verts

  - SM_Tunnel_Metro_Traffic_Light_RB_for_wall - 9372 Tris / 5018 Verts

Unity Specification:

  - 9 PBR Materials

  - 10 Textures

  - Texture Sizes: 4096*4096

  - Textures Maps: BaseColor, Normal, ORM (Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic in package), Emissive

  - 1 Shader (for Built-in)

  - 8 Meshes

description_text:
Animated with a liquid simulator, 250 frame of realistically flowing fountain water, shooting upwards then falling to the ground. 
The file itself is an ALEMBIC file, ie. and .abc file. Also enclosed a 3ds max scene file, but you need to browse for the alembic file there.
An OBJ and FBX files are also attached but they are only a still frame of the fountain water flow.
You can drag and drop to any scenes into your 3d application which accepts .acb files. 
All the main 3d applications supports .abc files, here is a list of 3d applications which supports .abc files:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alembic_(computer_graphics)
Apply any material, there are three examples in the previews, rendered in vray, but you can render it in any engine with any materials.
The fountain example scene is only for presentational purposes, that scene is NOT part of this 3d model.
You can set a custom timeframe, or you can just use it as a still frame. If you have any questions, let me know.
Thank you, sincerely yours,Motionblur Studios Team

description_text:
EV charging stationA charging station, also called electric vehicle charging station, electric recharging point, charging point, charge point, electronic charging station (ECS), and electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), is a machine that supplies electric energy to charge plug-in electric vehicles—including cars, neighborhood electric vehicles, trucks, buses, and others.
Some electric vehicles have onboard converters that plug into a standard electrical outlet or a higher voltage outlet. Others use custom charging stations.
Charging stations provide connectors that conform to a variety of standards. For common direct current rapid charging, chargers are equipped with multiple adaptors such as Combined Charging System (CCS), CHAdeMO, and AC fast charging.
Public charging stations are typically found street-side or at retail shopping centers, government facilities and parking areas.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia:To the Struggle Against World Terrorism (also known as the Tear of Grief and the Tear Drop Memorial) is a 10–story sculpture by Zurab Tsereteli that was given to the United States as an official gift from the Russian government as a memorial to the victims of the September 11 attacks in 2001, and the 1993 World Trade Center bombing. It stands at the end of the former Military Ocean Terminal in Bayonne, New Jersey. Ceremonial groundbreaking occurred on September 16, 2005, in a ceremony attended by Russian President Vladimir Putin. The monument was dedicated on September 11, 2006, in a ceremony attended by former U.S. President Bill Clinton.

description_text:
Medieval&Fantasy Set is a 3D models and materials package for games and visualizations. With this package you can create your own medieval village from zero, or enriching your project with some additions. The preview pictures have been taken within a Unity scene, where I created a scene using only the assets included in this package, except for vegetation and particles, which comes from the amazing Meadow Environment asset from Nature Manufacture. The package contains the .fbx models and the textures to create PBR materials, not the scene in the preview.
In this package are included 118 3D models UV mapped and 35 texture folders, each of them to create a PBR material.The different files in the package are organized as follows:1) 3D models are in .fbx format, subdivided in 5 main categories that you can find in the FBX files folder. In the .fbx file models have only Diffuse map applied, but when you decide the software to render, you can apply the other maps.Suggestion: if you want to put them inside a game project, you should create LOD stages, in order to keep performances high (you can just use the decimate modifier in Blender for example).
01_Gate&Walls - 8 models, 69826 verts, 85022 faces02_Doors&Windows - 17 models, 107435 verts, 117954 faces03_Building_bases&samples - 36 models, 1058416 verts, 1132512 faces04_Wooden_elements - 20 models, 34651 verts, 44065 faces05_Stairs&street_elements - 37 models, 134096 verts, 144689
2) Textures are inside Texture maps folder. Each of the subfolders contains a number of texture maps, mainly in 4K (4096x4096), for Physically Based Rendering (PBR), so you usually find 4 different textures: Albedo/Diffuse, Roughness, Ambient Occlusion, Normal. Some materials also have a Metallic map, or a Displacement map if you want to use it.They are subdivided in 5 zip folders.
Enjoy the package, and if you have any question contact me at eli.luo93@gmail.com

Enjoy!

description_text:
Seven big, chunky, game-ready rocks in various sizes for your real time 3D project. All assets have been carefully designed to look great and highly detailed from all angles. Lots of cavities and interesting shapes make it easy to combine these rocks with 3D terrains and create an appealing and very varied look.
All these versatile rocks come with textures both for classic deferred and PBR rendering. On top of that we added five sets of detail maps which can help to achieve a crisp and sharp look even from close distance (provided your rendering pipeline supports detail map rendering).
Contents:
Seven rock assets in Blender, OBJ and FBX formats with following polycounts:

  - Rock L01: 1,834 Tris

  - Rock L02: 2,030 Tris

  - Rock L03: 2,312 Tris

  - Rock L04: 1,702 Tris

  - Rock M01: 1,700 Tris

  - Rock S01: 1,572 Tris

  - Rock S02: 1,966 Tris

Following texture maps are included in 2048x2048 resolutions – uniquely created for each asset:

  - Diffuse

  - Specular

  - Normal Map (Y-)

  - Normal Map (Y+)

  - Albedo

  - Ambient Occlusion

  - Smoothness

  - Smoothness + Metallic (works best with Unity’s standard shader)

And on top of that you also get five detail maps (Albedo/Normal) in 1024x1024 resolution.
Any questions? Don’t hesitate to contact us!

description_text:
This is my version of the Twilight Zone Eyes of the beholder mask
This was always my favorite episode and I loved the masks they were so recreated one to use for fun or for Covid. 
The mask is designed to use cloth of any kind in the air inlets and use a plug to hold the material in place, I still need to finish the plug design but for now the material could just be pushed into place. I should have the plugs finished in the next few days but I wanted to go ahead and get this mask uploaded for the public to try out.
I designed this with printing in mind, and have printed my own out with supports only at the base of the mask, to help keep the fine detail in the print. if your machine does bridging well then this should be fine for you also but some machines might require more support then others.  
Everyones face is differenent so I cannot design this to fit everyone perfect but I have tried to make it universal the best I can. If you want a perfect fit please pay attention to the scale or use some sort of liquid rubber around the edge.  I used Scandy Pro to 3d scan my face to base my mask shape off of. 
Please, Do not share/resale the 3d model
I don't mind selling of the prints as long as GrizzlyMountainDesigns is refered as the modeler :) Please feel free to message with any other questions or reguests! for even better deals, check out our patreon at patreon.com/grizzlymountaindesigns
If you like my designs/models check out our instagram Grizzlymountaindesigns or on the patreon, same name!
I do custom models so let me know if there's anything you think would be a good hit!

description_text:
this set of Japanese arrowheads consists out different types of arrows that are historical used by Japanese hunters, warriors and samurai. archery was not just used for one purpose but was used for many different things. because of this, many different types of arrow heads were developed.
for example, some specific arrows were long, slender en light. these kind of arrows do not as much damage as arrows with larger heads but are much better at piercing light armor and tough hides, making them excellent for the many wars that japan waged . its also the type of arrow where the design reduced the amount of metal needed the most. Good steel used to be expensive in Japan after all.
a other example are the forked arrows. These are designed to hunt small animals and birds. because of their shape they have a higher chance to hit their target while also doing enough damage to catch them.
These models are based on real Edo period arrowheads that have been preserved.
Model information:

  - made for 3d printing.

  - textures are added in case of digital use.

  - based on real Edo period arrowheads.

  - quads only.

  - subdivision ready.

  - hand modeled.

  - low poly and optimal for real time render

Disclaimer – in case of printing these arrow heads in metal, please check with your countries law and regulations beforehand. Even although arrowheads like these are legal in most places, some countries prohibit the use and/or possession of metal arrow heads with cutting edges.
– in case of use for hunting, please note that not all of these arrow heads are traditionally used for this purpose, and those that are, are used for different types of targets. Pleas only use for hunting if you know what you are doing.
– Japanese arrow heads are traditionally made out of steel (Tamahagane or Oroshigane) or steel lamination. When replicating these arrow heads for use on an arrow shafts, pleas make sure to use a material of similar strength or better to avoid accidents.
– polymath maniac is not responsible for any damage or injuries caused by use or misuse of these arrow heads. When printed with a hard material, these arrow heads are considered weapons and should be treated with care and respect.

description_text: This is a model of an outboard engine gear case. Below, i'll explain how it works for someone that doesn't know.The power from the crankshaft of the engine is driven to the gear on the top pinion through the driveshaft, which is fited with a nut below the pinion. The pinion then delivers the power (rotational) to the 2 gears next to it. The gears are rotating with opposite rotation. (the pinion and gears are rotating all the time the engine is powerd on...) Then with a lever (which usually is placed on the left side of the outboard or to your remote control) the clutch which is between the gears, is moved to the desired direction. Then the clutch is fited with the gear (because of its shape) and as the clutch is mounted on the propeller shaft, it rotates the propeller, which eventually moves the boat. If we want to put in the other gear (reverse or forward) we move the clutch to the opposite gear. When the clutch is in the middle position, your engine is in neutral. All gears as long as the pinion and the clutch as placed inside the lower Unit of the engine and are sank into oil (to reduce friction and wear).Along with the native Solidworks file, you can also find parasolid, iges and step formats as well as stl, amf and 3mf. Polygon file is also attached. Can be used for 3D printing.

Das größte Kunstmuseum Schwedens ist das Nationale Kunstmuseum Schwedens. Das Gebäude, das sich in Stockholm befindet, beherbergt eine beeindruckende Sammlung von etwa 16.000 Gemälden und Skulpturen. Das Nationale Kunstmuseum ist auch für die Verwaltung von Kunstwerken in zahlreichen Schlössern verantwortlich, darunter Gripsholm, Drottningholm, Strömsholm, Rosersberg und Ulriksdal. Zusätzlich dazu betreut das Museum das Porzellanmuseum in Gustavsberg.

La Haye Sainte ist ein Gutshof an der Straße zwischen Charleroi und Brüssel. Er spielte während der Schlacht von Waterloo 1815 eine wichtige Rolle. Marshall Ney eroberte diesen Gutshof zum Abend des 18. Juni 1815 und wurde am späterem Abend wieder geschlagen und aus dem Gutshof vertrieben.
Das Modell enthält den fertigen Gutshof in den Maßstäben 1:1000, 1:100 und 1:56. Die easy print version für die einzelnen Häuser und die Mauern sind in dem Maßstab 1:100 angefertigt. Skalierung dafür:178%: 1:56139%: 1:72

description_text:
Earl Louis Curly Lambeau (/ˈlæmboʊ/ LAM-boh; April 9, 1898 – June 1, 1965) was an American professional football player and coach in the National Football League (NFL). Lambeau, along with his friend and fellow Green Bay, Wisconsin native, George Whitney Calhoun, founded the Green Bay Packers in 1919. He served as team captain in the team's first year before becoming player-coach in 1920. As a player, Lambeau lined up as a halfback, which in the early years of the NFL was the premier position. He was the team's primary runner and passer, accounting for 35 touchdowns (eight as a rusher, three as a receiver, and 24 as a passer) in 77 games. He won his only NFL championship as a player in 1929.
From 1920 to 1949, Lambeau was the head coach and general manager of the Packers, with near-total control over the team's day-to-day operations. He led his team to over 200 wins and six NFL championships, including three straight from 1929 to 1931. He is tied with rival George Halas of the Chicago Bears and Bill Belichick of the New England Patriots for the most NFL championships by a coach. Lambeau also coached eight players who went on to be elected into the Pro Football Hall of Fame. With players such as quarterback Arnie Herber and split end Don Hutson, his teams revolutionized the use of the passing game in football. After a falling-out with the Packers' board of directors, Lambeau left the Packers to coach the Chicago Cardinals and Washington Redskins, each for two seasons, before retiring in 1953.
For his accomplishments, Lambeau has been widely recognized and honored. He was named to the NFL 1920s All-Decade Team as one of the top halfbacks in the league's first decade of existence. He was an inaugural inductee to the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1963 and the Green Bay Packers Hall of Fame in 1970 in recognition for his role as founder, player, and coach of the Packers. Two months after his death in 1965, the Packers home stadium, which is still in use today, was renamed Lambeau Field in his honor.

description_text: This striking 3D model depicts a meticulously detailed reconstruction of a Neanderthal head based on scientific evidence and fossil records. The sculpture captures our ancient human relative with remarkable anatomical accuracy, featuring the species' characteristic robust facial features. The model showcases pronounced brow ridges, a wide nose, receding chin, and powerful jaw structure that distinguished Homo neanderthalensis from modern humans. The textured beard and facial hair blend into a realistic portrayal of how these prehistoric humans might have appeared. The weathered, rugged appearance reflects adaptation to harsh Ice Age European environments. Dimensions are 20 cm length, 20 cm width, and 3 cm thickness. This expertly crafted model is perfect for anthropology enthusiasts, educational institutions, museums, paleontological collectors, or anyone interested in human evolution. Ideal for 3D printing, educational displays, or scientific visualization.

description_text:
Derawar Fort is a fortress in Ahmadpur East Tehsil of Bahawalpur District in the Punjab, Pakistan. Approximately 20 km south of the city of Ahmedpur East,The forty bastions of Derawar are visible for many miles in the Cholistan Desert. The walls have a perimeter of 1500 metres and stand up to thirty metres high. Derawar Fort was originally founded as a Bhati fort in the 9th century CE, and renovated in 1732 by Nawab Sadeq Mohammad Khan.
What is Derawar Fort famous for?Derawar and the Desert Forts of Cholistan was submitted by the Pakistan Government in 2016 to be considered as a World Heritage Site.
I was Inspired by this huge architect then I decided to re-create in 3d model then I made it in Autodesk Maya it’s a low poly game-ready 3d model suitable for AR/ VR, Mix Reality, Metaverse, Unreal Engine & Unity.Included 8k PBR texture with fbx + obj + Source file. Please leave a comment and share your views on my work.
Thanks

Organic stone pots - Landscape builder (1- or 2-color)
A sphere landscape with plant-pots permeated with a organic net. Print some of the organic stone pots and build a individual landscape.
There are three spheres-pot parts available (small, medium, large) with 1-2 different organic structures. For the private use, you can as many print as you like, and then combine it to a landscape. There is also a three in one landscape composition available.

Images: The photos show the three two-color parts, printed with a sandstone like filament (spheres/pots) and green wood (organic net). I use 5 layers,so the pots are possible waterproof.

description_text:
Something I actually made years ago, before all the fictional stadiums I’ve uploaded, it’s the first stadium I ever made with gangways & concourses inside the stands connected to access/exit ways, so despite it’s not as good as my most detailed stadiums (that’s why I prioritized the upload of more recent stadiums), is still pretty good, besides being a big step forward in my improvement process.
It’s an old olympic stadium that became a football stadium that meets most of the international requirements without eliminating any stand, becoming a great football stadium while keeping the classic architectonic style.
You get both stadiums complete in separate files in OBJ, FBX, DAE, DXF & the native SKP, in which you’ll find a third file with both stadiums, you just have to use the scene tabs to shift between the two; which was the point of making this model.
Before conversion: 
Capacity= 46,549 people.
Lower tier= 28,575.
Higher tier= 16,054.
VIP tier= 1,920.
Press (not included in total)= 474; 136 with desks, 326 w/o desks and 12 in commentators boxes).
After conversion:
Capacity= 72,691 people.
Lower tier= 40,796.
Higher tier= 28,955.
VIP tier= 2,588.
VIP boxes= 56 (7 each).
Wheelchair positions and companion= 296 (148/148).
Press (not included in total)= 496; 136 with desks, 336 w/o desks and 24 in commentators boxes.
IMPORTANT: These images (except for the last six) were taken from the same OBJ file available on another marketplace through its viewer, all formats are rudimentary exports directly from the native SKP file. Also, the polygons and vertices I wrote on the corresponding fields are an average between the before and after versions, naturally, the after version has much higher numbers than the before version.

description_text:
Electrical distribution cabinet object -7- out of the electrical distribution cabinet collection.
PBR texture maps: 
The textures for the model were baked with a pixel resolution of 16k in Blender-2.82a, later I scaled down the textures to 8k.I personally think that a pixel resolution of 2k is more than enough for the most uses of this small object!

  - 2k, 4k and 8k pixel resolution

  - Base color map

  - Metallic map

  - Roughness map

  - Normal map

  - Ambient Occlusion map

  - Cavity map

  - Not overlapping uvs

Geometry: 

  - Polygons 658

  - Vertices 480

Included 3D formats:  

  - Blender-2.82a (blend)

  - Alembic (abc)

  - Collada (dae)

  - Autodesk FBX (fbx)

  - Alias/WaveFront Material (mtl) 

  - OBJ (obj)

  - Polygon File Format (ply)

  - Stereolithography (stl)

  - X3D (x3d)

  - gLTF (gltf)

  - DXF

Used software and 3d-model creator.
Here on CGTrader you can find some of our 3D models, which we use in our projects for our Software VIS-All-3D ( https://vis-all.de/ )

  - Modeled and textured with Blender 2.82a ( https://www.blender.org/ )

description_text:
These cars are rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender files, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this collection is calculated on it's combination of cars relationship to other MCE cars and collections.The lower priced MCE collections have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced collections.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
Thes cars are made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exteriors
*Detailed interiors (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engines (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed undersides
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The cars are linked into several objects to make them more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The cars are royalty free, so you are free to modify and use them in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Average objects per car: 45
*Average polygons: 105.000
*Average verticles: 53.000
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl

description_text:
Column is an important part of the ancient Roman Greek architecture. A Roman Greek column typically consists of three parts: column cap or column capital, column base and column body. Column bases even in Greek architecture are fairly simple and dominated by different round configurations, which is often called Doric base column. However, the caps have many varieties. In general, Roman Greek column capitals can be classified into simple doric style column, contemporary ionic style column and ornamental corinthian style column.  Each category of column design yet has several variations. The Doric order was one of the three orders or organizational systems of ancient Greek or classical architecture; the other two canonical orders were the Ionic and the Corinthian.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Copenhagen Windmill Building. Wings are separated to suit the animation process.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.  
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 3732 Triangles

  - 1965 Polygons

  - 2842 Vertices

  - Model is built with two meshes.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are centered to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Follow Rescue3D Assets !
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Rescue3Dassets
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rescue3dassets
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/Rescue3DAssets
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rescue3dassets
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKuB8qTeRtiX0vye9qverw/
Website: https://www.rescue3d.com  
Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
This is a 3D model of a realistic tennis ball for 3Dsmax/Redshift/Vray. Felt (hair) was created using Ornatrix, so you will need to install the Ornatrix demo in order to render it. No need to buy a license, the demo is free (the only one you need to render).
You get:

  - A clean topology with clean uvs ball model with 2 materials (and 2 ids), the yellow and the grey part.

  - 2 versions of felt (hair of the ball), short for a newer/tidier look, and longer for a worn, used and fluffier look. The felt is an Ornatrix object,  collapsed and cannot be edited, it's ready for render.

  - Materials with procedural maps for Redshift 3.* and Vray 5  inside 3Ds max, and 4K textures of those maps if you need to render outside 3Dsmax. 

  - 3dsmax 2020 scene with lights and camera, already setup for  Redshift and Vray 5.

  - Ball and fur are attached to a dummy for rotation. If you don't need this, just unparent them. 

  - I've added alembic and OBJ versions of the fur and the ball (they are over 1M polys!), so that you can import them to Cinema4D, Blender, Houdini or Maya. The look you get might be different due to the differences between apps. Sample renders have been created with 3dsmax and Redshift and Vray when stated. Both Alembic and Obj versions should carry UVS to any 3D app of your choice. Warning! It won't look the same in other apps other than 3Ds MAX due to the fact that you are not using Ornatrix!

Enjoy!

description_text:
This is the 3d representation of  the Superbowl LIX logo. It contains PBR textures (Color, Metallic, Roughness, Height and Normal maps) . I've included the model of the trophy alone, if you want to use only it. The textures included are both for a generic trophy(without LIX written in it) as for the Superbowl LIX, you only have to change the Roughness, Normal and Height Maps.
Renders were made in Maya using Redshift, textures were painted in Substance Painter. The files also contains the HDR used in the render and the Substance Painter file, so you can change anything you like. 
"Super Bowl LIX is the upcoming American football championship game of the National Football League (NFL) for the 2024 season. The game is scheduled to be played on February 9, 2025, at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans, Louisiana.
The official logo follows the logo template established since Super Bowl LVI, with the Roman numerals featuring imagery representing the host city/region. For this event, the Roman numerals contain artwork by local artist Queen Tahj Williams—a figure in the community of Mardi Gras Indians. It marks the first time the NFL collaborated with a local artist on the design of a Super Bowl emblem.
The design—originally created with beads—features Mardi Gras inspired red, green, and gold-colored fleur-de-lis patterns (a symbol long connected with New Orleans and used as the logo for the New Orleans Saints), evoking the designs of ironwork balconies common in the city's architecture (particularly in the French Quarter).

Old Trafford is a football stadium in Old Trafford, Greater Manchester, England, and is the home of Manchester United. description_text:
A professional, high-quality 3D model collection of a Tennis Umpire Chair (Referee High Chair). This asset includes three distinct color variations (Classic Green, Elegant Maroon/Brown, and Minimalist White) complete with sun canopies and writing desk armrests. Modeled with precision and rendered with realistic materials, it is perfect for sports simulations, stadium visualizations, tennis court animations, and archival renderings.
[ FEATURES ]
High Quality Geometry: Clean, professional polygonal topology, optimized for both high-end rendering and seamless viewport performance.
3 Color Variations: Features 3 fully textured versions (Green with side panels, Maroon with side panels, and White open-frame skeleton).
Format Versatility: Native 3ds Max format with VRay setup, plus popular interchange formats (Blender, FBX, OBJ) for universal compatibility.
Accurate Scale: Modeled in real-world scale with correct proportions based on real tennis tournament equipment.
Ready to Render: Fully textured and shaded. Drop it into your scene and hit render instantly.
[ FILE FORMATS INCLUDED ]
3ds Max (.max): Native file, setup with V-Ray materials, textures, and lighting environment.
Blender (.blend): Fully compatible, materials applied and ready for Cycles/Eevee.
FBX (.fbx): Universal format with baked textures/materials embedded, ideal for importing into Maya, Cinema 4D, or Game Engines.
OBJ (.obj + .mtl): Standard wave-front format with accompanying material file.
[ SPECIFICATIONS & TOPOLOGY ]
Software Used: 3ds Max (Modeling) / V-Ray (Rendering)
Texturing/Shading: Fully textured with high-resolution maps.
UV Mapping: Clean, non-overlapping UV coordinates.

description_text:
The Realistic 1980s Pop Icon Bad Tour Dance Pose Statue is an exceptionally dynamic, PBR-ready 3D model that captures the raw, high-octane energy of the world’s greatest entertainer during his legendary late-1980s solo stadium tour peak. Frozen in a high-intensity mid-performance dance break, this full-body sculpture showcases the artist clad in his iconic multi-buckled leather performance jacket, complete with asymmetrical zippers, tactical arm straps, a heavy metal utility corset belt, and tight-fitted rock trousers accented by leg buckles. The character is depicted gripping a vintage stage microphone close to his chest while sustaining a masterful toe-balance lean. Positioned firmly on a low-profile circular marble-textured stage base, this digital sculpture is a magnificent masterpiece for pop culture collectors, rock-pop memorabilia enthusiasts, or hobby miniature painters.
Use: Music room centerpiece, 80s rock-pop collection ornament, premium recording studio desktop display, advanced scale model figure painting project.
Originality: A masterful study in mid-dance physical tension, highlighting realistic leather texture folds, detailed metal hardware buckles, and a gravity-defying stage posture.
Essential Value: A pristine digital sculpture explicitly engineered to keep individual jacket straps, zipper teeth, and fine curly hair strands highly defined, making it an incredibly satisfying model to print and paint.
Keywords (SEO): pop king 3d print, bad tour stl, buckled leather jacket 3d model, dirty diana singer statue, 1987 concert figurine print, heavy metal belt stl, microphone stage dancer sculpture, fbx obj stl.
Context of Use, Limitations & InspirationsContext: Perfect for placing alongside vintage 80s vinyl records, concert ticket stubs, custom glass cabinets, or as a premier premium gift for dedicated live music video historians.
Limitations: The extreme crouched dance posture creates unique negative spaces under the arms and between the bent knees. Strategic support placement is critical underneath the mic-holding hand, elbows, and jacket tails to avoid surface scarring during post-processing.
Inspirations: Heavily inspired by the iconic 1987 punk-rock infused short films, explosive world tour opening choreography, and premium collectible designer scale statues.
Technical & Manufacturing InstructionsMachine CompatibilityFDM Printers: Creality, Prusa, Anycubic, Bambu Lab (An outstanding candidate for large-scale statue printing using ultra-fine layer settings to accurately capture the detailed jacket straps).
Resin Printers (SLA/DLP): Elegoo Mars, Anycubic Photon, Phrozen Sonic (The ultimate choice at standard desktop scale to draw out absolute sharpness across the micro buckles and facial features).
Recommended MaterialsPLA / PETG: Carbon-fiber black, dark titanium, or matte dark gray PLAs yield a beautiful, premium appearance straight off the build plate.
Resin: High-tensile, ABS-like, or specialized tough gray resins are highly recommended to add critical durability to the thin microphone stand and outstretched fingers.
Recommended Print SettingsLayer Height: 0.10 mm – 0.14 mm (FDM) / 0.03 mm – 0.05 mm (Resin).
Infill: 25–35% (Using a heavier, denser infill pattern inside the lower legs and circular stage base keeps the model perfectly balanced).
Supports: Required. Clean tree or organic supports are mandatory under the chin, the microphone cord, both elbows, the lower jacket edges, and between the upper thighs.
Shells/Walls: 3–4 walls recommended for strong exterior layers.
Assembly & Finishing InstructionsPost-Processing: Use extreme caution and fine flush-cutters when snipping away support material near the narrow mic cord and curly hair clusters. Smooth down any support remnants using fine-grit sand-sponges to preserve the surrounding leather textures.
Priming & Painting: Apply a solid coat of dark gray or black primer. Paint the tactical suit a rich semi-gloss black, then use a fine detail brush with bright metallic silver or chrome to pick out every individual strap buckle, zipper line, and corset rivet to match the iconic stage look.
Finishing Touches: Coat the skin and main fabrics in a clean matte varnish. Apply a high-gloss clear lacquer exclusively over the leather shoes, the microphone head, and the main jacket panels to create an eye-catching material contrast under spotlight displays.
Safety & Usage Standards
  - Usage Notice:
This is a digital file download intended entirely for 3D printing manufacturing purposes.
Long-term structural balance and center-of-gravity reliability are wholly dependent on the user's end material selections, wall thickness, and print orientation.
Keep the finished print away from direct high-heat showcases or intense heat lamps to eliminate any warping risks over time if using standard PLA.

American Football Goal is a three-dimensional model of upright structures located at each end of the American Football playing field, used for scoring points by kicking the football through them during a field goal attempt or extra point kick.
The American Football goal posts that consist of two vertical uprights connected by a horizontal crossbar, with the special uprights extending upward from the back of the end zone. The American Football goal posts can be located at the back of the end zone and are used as a target for kickers to aim for when attempting to score points.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Yamato Class Battleship model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Yamato-class battleships were built between 1937 and 1942.  The lead ship of the class, Yamato, was commissioned just after the attack on Pearl Harbor and was present for the Battle of Midway. Only two Yamato-class battleships were completed as designed, while a third was converted into an aircraft carrier and two were never finished. The Yamato-class battleships hold the record for being the largest battleships ever constructed and also carrying the largest naval guns. Due to aircraft carriers and submarines making battleships obsolete, it is unlikely these records will ever be beaten.  The ships carried a main battery of nine eighteen-inch guns with a secondary battery consisting of twelve six-inch guns and twelve five-inch guns. 
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.

  - Update 14 Aug 19: Added anchor chains and floatplane rails. Adjustments for better printability.

  - Update 23 May 26: Added three variants; now including 1941, 1944, 1945 refits as well as a hypothetical variant using twin four-inch turrets as tertiary mounts.

Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, metalness, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY
Geometry provided is low poly mesh. Mesh is subdividable up to its original sculpt level of 6 to accurately reveal all tiny details of displacement map.Model is designed to provide optimal detail/performance level you need. Not only high detail close-up renders are possible, but lower subdivision level/not subdivided mesh can also be used in game environments.

  - Geometry centered on the origin

  - Real world scale (units: centimeters)

  - Polygonal quads only

  - No poles with more than 5 edges

  - Displacement distance (useful in other software packages):  1.0 cm

  - UVs: linear

TEXTURES
Textures are photorealistic 8192x8192 (32 bit per channel EXR) images, created from real object capture data.Each model UV's were created and inspected according to its specific surface characteristic. This enables to find the optimal balance of maximum texture space allocation, intuitive layout, easy further 2d texture editing possibilities and minimal texture distortion.Textures are designed to fit linear UVs (no internal smoothing, locked UV borders) to avoid UV smoothing errors. Geometry of evenly sized quads guarantees low linear UV texture distortion when subdivided.
Textures used in provided Blender scene:

  - Albedo

  - Metalness

  - Roughness

  -  Vector Displacement

  - Spherical 16384x8192 HDRI map texture

Additional textures provided in separate archive:

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

No third-party plug-ins used.Scene created in Blender 2.8.

description_text:
Located near the very center of the continental United States, Kansas City is the largest city in Missouri. Founded close to Missouri’s Western border with Kansas, the city sits above the confluence of the Kansas and Missouri Rivers. As Kansas City grew rapidly throughout the late 19th and early 20th centuries, the metropolis came to boast an impressive collection of pre-war buildings scattered through its historic downtown core. Many of the largest and most famous buildings were built amidst the boom and bust of the 1920s and 30s, when the city was under the control of Tom Pendergast and the corrupt political machine he created. This collection contains models of 6 famous Kansas City skyscrapers named and described below in the order they appear in the images.

  - The Kansas City Power & Light Building is a 481ft (147m) tall skyscraper on the Southern end of the city’s downtown loop. Designed for its namesake energy company by architecture firm Hoit, Price & Barnes, the building was completed in 1931. The building stood as the tallest building in both the city and state. It was also the tallest building in the United States constructed West of the Mississippi River.Its classic art deco design and magnificent illuminated crown make it a cherished landmark of the city. While the Kansas City Power & Light Company has since gone out of business, the building's original name has remained and has come to lend its name to the Power & Light District, the surrounding area that features cultural attractions to revitalize downtown Kansas City.In the decades since the tower's opening, its offices have been vacated and the building has been converted to residential use.

  - 909 Walnut is a 471ft (144m) tall highrise designed by Hoit, Price & Barnes and finished in 1931. Upon its completion, 909 Walnut was the 2nd tallest building in the city and the state of Missouri for 45 years. The tower's unique twin spires and fusion of Art Deco and Gothic Revival architecture make it a Kansas City landmark.Originally named the Fidelity National Bank & Trust Building, its namesake bank went under soon after construction of the building due to the Great Depression. From there, it was purchased and used by the US federal government. In recent years, the building has been repurposed for residential use. During its conversion, the clock that once adorned the Northern spire was removed. This model recreates the building as it was originally designed with its clock faces.

  - The Oak Tower, also known as the Bell Telephone Building, was designed by Hoit, Price & Barnes in collaboration with I.R. Timlin in a Gothic-Revival style. Originally constructed in 1913 at a height of 185ft (56m), the building was later doubled in height in 1929. At its final height of 379ft (116m), it briefly held the title of Kansas City and the state of Missouri's tallest building until eclipsed by 909 Walnut and the Power & Light Building.In 1974, when the building was sold to new owners, its magnificent gothic ornamentation was buried beneath stucco. While today the tower's historic facade remains hidden, this model aims to recreate the original design in its full beauty.

  - The Bryant Building is 318ft (97m) tall and built in 1930. Designed by Chicago-based architecture firm Graham Anderson Probst and White, the building is a sleek example of Art Deco architecture. Its multi-color terra cotta and metal paneling is arranged in a way to, in conjunction with characteristic setbacks, accentuate the vertical elements of the building. For a brief period upon its completion, it was the 2nd tallest building in the city. Today, it functions as a data center.

  - City Hall is an art deco skyscraper standing 433ft (135m) tall. A flagpole atop the building, while not counted towards the building’s official height, tops out at 525ft (160m) high. The massive building houses the city’s administrative offices and ranks among the world’s tallest municipal buildings. Constructed in 1937, it used funds from the Public Works Administration, an agency established as part of President FDR’s New Deal program. Much of this money ended up in the pockets of contractors closely involved with Pendergast’s patronage network. The architects, Wight & Wight, designed the building in a style that combines an austere neoclassical and art deco that make heavy use of bas-relief artwork in its facade common throughout Depression era projects.

  - The Jackson County Courthouse stands directly South of City Hall across 12th St, creating a large public space around Kansas City’s greatest monuments to civic service. Also designed by Wight & Wight, its similar design makes it a shorter architectural companion to City Hall. The design of the building was guided by then future-president Harry S. Truman, who was the presiding judge of Jackson County. The 295ft (90m) tall building, completed in 1934, was also constructed as part of the New Deal’s public works programs.

NOTES:

  - The Kansas City Power & Light Building, 909 Walnut, Oak Tower, and City Hall are all available for purchase individually

  - Models were designed for the sole purpose of 3D Printing. However, included are .zip folders that contain the models in other formats with very basic materials as seen in the above images for use in other 3D modeling software.

  - Background Image on Preview Slide is sourced from the Internet Archive Book and is public domain

description_text:
The models (12 in total) have real world scale. Every book is a seperate object (except, in the .ply-file they are joined together), but they are all grouped. The bottom of the objects are on the same level. The first two images show, how they are presented in the file (between each origin point lie 10 cm).
The given polygon and vertice count is for all objects together: one book consists of 8 vertices and 6 polygons.
Used texture and maps are included: one texture / diffuse map, one glossy map (invert for roughness) and one normal map. Each image measures 5120 x 5120 px. UVs are unwrapped and everything is named logically.
The following list, shows the books included (the publication year applies to the featured edition and there might have been earlier versions):

  - Sunshine and Showers by June Francis (2010)

  - Nancy's War by Anne Baker (2011)

  - Daughters of the Mersey by Anne Baker (2012)

  - Lights of Liverpool by Ruth Hamilton (2012)

  - A Liverpool Legacy by Anne Baker (2013)

  - From Liverpool with Love by Lyn Andrews (2014)

  - Child of the Mersey by Annie Groves (2014)

  - Liverpool Gems by Anne Baker (2016)

  - War Widow by June Francis (2018)

  - A Liverpool Secret by Geraldine O'Neill (2018)

  - The Land is Bright by Elizabeth Murphy (2019)

  - Liverpool Lamplight by Lyn Andrews (2020)

Do not hesitate to ask any questions.

description_text:
Low-poly historical accurate reconstruction of the Faule Mette (Lazy Mette) of Brunswick in its firing position. It was cast from bronze in 1411. It got its name because it was too heavy to be placed on a carriage. In 1714 it was considered to be the biggest cannon in Germany. In 1787 it was melted down and recast into several lighter guns.
The file includes:

  - Gun with two different texture sets (cleaned and patinated version)

  - Cannon bed for firing made from heavy wooden beams

  - Some stone balls as ammunition

Polys/Verts

  - Faule Mette (1,363/1,420)

  - Cannon bed (859/924)

  - Per stone ball (96/98)

Further Information
Models are:

  - Fully mapped and textured with PBR material (4k) (stone balls only 1k).

  - In real world scale (meters).

  - Logically grouped, layered, attached and named.

  - Ready for subdivision (support loops)-UnrealEngine UASSET is imported with Nanite

description_text:
1950 Citroen H Van as a storge box. Designed for 3D FDM printing. This is a fun project that has the look of the original but designed for ease of printing.Print all objects flat, no supports needed.Use it for storing your phone, pencils, napkins, sugars, keys, anything that fits. It has a generous opening at the top and is easy to print.There are 6 body parts and a set of wheels. Instructions included.
An old distressed paint finish complements the model and just go crazy with printing out some paper stickers to finish the vintage look. See photos for some ideas. The finished Van looks like it's made of timber, quite strong and could be used as a long term childs toy. Printing the wheels with greater infill would make them stronger if used as a toy.Sample models in Photos printed on Anycubic Kobra and Mega Zero 2.0, trouble free printing.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Radar Tower.
The model is divided into two meshes to suit the animation process.
The first part is the base part and the second is a radar part that you can rotate and animate.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO texture set

  - 6974 Triangles

  - 3658 Polygons

  - 5572 Vertices

  - Model is divided into two meshes to suit the animation process.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

description_text:
A carport designed for 2 cars to park under. Footprint is approximately 5*5m. Approximately 2.4 metres tall at the front and 2 metres tall at the back. Roof is sloped slightly at 5 degrees. A gutter and downpipe is included for the lower end.
The carport is provided as multiple variants. The native Blender file is included with the object modifiers left unapplied (flat_metal_carport_original.blend). Two zip files offer a high-poly version and low-poly version. The high poly version has all modifiers applied and is offered in many file formats. The low poly version has no modifiers and therefore has sharp edges and many of the parts are a single face thick.
Geometry:

  - All objects have been left separated to allow for easy modification.

  - Quads and tris with some planar ngons (they do not cause artifacts)

  - Not subdividable

  - Smooth shading with custom edge normal data (for some sharp edges)

  - Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres

  - The high resolution version is entirely watertight. The other versions are not.

Texturing:

  - 3 basic PBR textures, Color, normal, specular. 

  - 1024*1024 resolution (1K)

  - png and jpg format

  - UV mapped with overlap. Uses tiling textures.

  - Created in Blender. .blend file has textures packed (embedded in the file).

First of 10 buildings for a complete post-apocalyptic town/shelter area.  New building to be uploaded every 1-2 weeks, depending on the complexity of the building.

4k textures packed in blendes, as well as separate.

description_text:
Hi Guys,Check out this useful Geometry Node for Chain Link Fence. It gives you a possibility to create a fence in just 2 sec. Just apply this GeoNode to the curve you want your fence to follow and it's done. Feel free to tweak the settings in the Modifier Properties to get the fence you need.One of the most useful thing you can find in modifier properties is Faux Hedge. It makes your nice, but a little bit boring fence green and beautiful. This feature may be quite expansive for PC, so wisely controll leaves density in accordance to the size of the fence.This Geometry Node doesn't use any Object Info or Collection Info. It is completely done with the mesh and curve primitives of the Geometry Node Editor. The most challenging and therefore the most exciting part of working on this GeoNode was to model a chain link grid mesh using primitives.
*All Nodes in the Editor are clean, joined into frames and named, so it is easy to read, edit and reuse different parts of it.

About
A crane is a type of machine, generally equipped with a hoist rope, wire ropes or chains, and sheaves, that can be used both to lift and lower materials and to move them horizontally. It is mainly used for lifting heavy objects and transporting them to other places. The device uses one or more simple machines to create mechanical advantage and thus move loads beyond the normal capability of a human. Cranes are commonly employed in transportation for the loading and unloading of freight, in construction for the movement of materials, and in manufacturing for the assembling of heavy equipment. The first known crane machine was the shaduf, a water-lifting device that was invented in ancient Mesopotamia (modern Iraq) and then appeared in ancient Egyptian technology. Construction cranes later appeared in ancient Greece, where they were powered by men or animals (such as donkeys), and used for the construction of buildings. Larger cranes were later developed in the Roman Empire, employing the use of human treadwheels, permitting the lifting of heavier weights. In the High Middle Ages, harbour cranes were introduced to load and unload ships and assist with their construction—some were built into stone towers for extra strength and stability. The earliest cranes were constructed from wood, but cast iron, iron and steel took over with the coming of the Industrial Revolution. For many centuries, power was supplied by the physical exertion of men or animals, although hoists in watermills and windmills could be driven by the harnessed natural power. The first mechanical power was provided by steam engines, the earliest steam crane being introduced in the 18th or 19th century, with many remaining in use well into the late 20th century.[1] Modern cranes usually use internal combustion engines or electric motors and hydraulic systems to provide a much greater lifting capability than was previously possible, although manual cranes are still utilized where the provision of power would be uneconomic. There are many different types of cranes, each tailored to a specific use. Sizes range from the smallest jib cranes, used inside workshops, to the tallest tower cranes, used for constructing high buildings. Mini-cranes are also used for constructing high buildings, to facilitate constructions by reaching tight spaces. Large floating cranes are generally used to build oil rigs and salvage sunken ships. Some lifting machines do not strictly fit the above definition of a crane, but are generally known as cranes, such as stacker cranes and loader cranes.

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - One different materials are included.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Renders have no post-processing.

  - All the objects of the model are named.

  - One UVW.

description_text:
A column or pillar in architecture and structural engineering is a vertical structural element that transmits, through compression, the weight of the structure above to other structural elements below. For the purpose of wind or earthquake engineering, columns may be designed to resist lateral forces. Other compression members are often termed "columns" because of the similar stress conditions. Columns are frequently used to support beams or arches on which the upper parts of walls or ceilings rest. In architecture, "column" refers to such a structural element that also has certain proportional and decorative features. A column might also be a decorative element not needed for structural purposes; many columns are "engaged with", that is to say form part of a wall.

description_text:
High-quality PBR low-poly 3D model of Street Clock.
 It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with all required PBR textures.
The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
PBR texture sets are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for a close-up.
Technical details:

  - 2 PBR textures sets (Body, Glass) 

  - 4096 PBR Body texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, AO)

  - 1024 PBR Glass texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, AO)

  - 6328 Triangles

  - 5833  Vertices

  - Model is one mesh

  - Model completely unwrapped

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world size (centimeters)

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named

PBR Texture sets details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Body PBR texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion)

  - 1024 x 1024 Glass PBR texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion)

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

description_text:
Famous landmark from each country in the world.
This project aims to create every single most famous landmark of every country in the world. This one pack contains the countries ranging from H to K (A total of 20 Countries).
The countries contained in this pack are:
-Honduras, Haiti, Vatican, Hungary, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Iran, Iraq, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jamaica, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kiribati, Kuwait and Kyrgyzstan.
Each monument/ landmark is labelled with the name of the country and the monument itself.
Technical details: All the models share the same material with the same texture and roughness map, there is 2 versions of the same texture: 24x24 px and 240x240 px (it can be upscaled even more if necessary).
Cards are included individually inside a zip file in full resolution made for a5 print size. All of them have a front and a dorso.
Export file formats are .FBX .GLB .STL .PLY .OBJ and native is .blend

description_text:
Avram Noam Chomsky (born December 7, 1928) is an American professor and public intellectual known for his work in linguistics, political activism, and social criticism. Sometimes called the father of modern linguistics, Chomsky is also a major figure in analytic philosophy and one of the founders of the field of cognitive science. He is a laureate professor of linguistics at the University of Arizona and an institute professor emeritus at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). Among the most cited living authors, Chomsky has written more than 150 books on topics such as linguistics, war, and politics. Ideologically, he aligns with anarcho-syndicalism and libertarian socialism.
Born to Ashkenazi Jewish immigrants in Philadelphia, Chomsky developed an early interest in anarchism from alternative bookstores in New York City. He studied at the University of Pennsylvania. During his postgraduate work in the Harvard Society of Fellows, Chomsky developed the theory of transformational grammar for which he earned his doctorate in 1955. That year he began teaching at MIT, and in 1957 emerged as a significant figure in linguistics with his landmark work Syntactic Structures, which played a major role in remodeling the study of language.

description_text:
This digital 3D model replicates the historic Pilate Stone, a crucial artifact for biblical and Roman history. Discovered in Caesarea Maritima, Israel, the original limestone block is inscribed in Latin, bearing the name of Pontius Pilate, the Roman prefect of Judea best known from the trial of Jesus as described in the Gospels. Dated to the early 1st century CE, the Pilate Stone provides rare archaeological confirmation of this historical figure’s existence and governance.Join the Facebook group: “Print Your Museum – 3D Printed Archaeology” https://www.facebook.com/groups/862838313343526
The 3D model precisely captures the weathered inscription, surface pitting, and authentic dimensions of the artifact. It allows users to closely study the epigraphic features and ancient Roman lettering, bringing the past into sharp focus through modern technology.
Technical features:
High-resolution 3D model with detailed inscription and realistic limestone texture
Fully optimized, watertight mesh for 3D printing and digital visualization
Multiple file formats included: STL, OBJ, FBX, ZTL
Applications:
Museum-quality replica for exhibitions and biblical archaeology studies
Educational demonstrations and research
Personal 3D printing for collectors, historians, and educators
Digital heritage preservation and virtual exploration
The Pilate Stone model enables students, researchers, and enthusiasts to engage directly with a landmark artifact, enriching understanding of Roman administration and New Testament archaeology.
Get other models for free, visit https://www.arqreation.com/print-your-museum/

description_text:
Hi-res 3d model of meadow-grass.
The bundle contains 10 different looking meadow-grass.
Can be used for close up shots or as scatter object on landscapes.When populated on landscapes the model is best used as instance or proxy because of the polycount (~20k quads per plant)

  - each model comes with 2K PBR textures (png), suitable for close up shots and animation

  - clean topology, mostly quads

  - carefully modelled to real world scale(centimeters)

  - materials and textures have unique and meaningful names

  - each model has proper unwrapped UVs (0-1 space).

Maya file has VRay Standard Materials (VRayMtl) assigned.Preview images rendered with VRay.
Two kinds of texture maps included:

  - Textures ready for V-Ray(diffuse, specular, glosiness), also suitable for most render enginges;

  - PBR metalness workflow (basecolor, metallic, roughness), ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and other real-time apps.

[{"score": 1, "comment": "These are quite good little low poly tree models, but there are some issues! I tried to import the FBX models into Twinmotion. They came in easy enough, but their pivot points are not at the base of the trunks, which is a bit frustrating. I then moved on the 3ds Max file, and in the same way the pivot point of the geometry was on at the base of the tree trunk. I had to edit every object to fix this, which is a bit frustrating. I would also like to make a suggestion for the materials too: the two colours, while clever to have them within the same texture,  would be better to be two separate materials, both pointing to the same texture. This would allow a user to easily change materials on the separate parts without editing the texture.
The trees are also a strange scale, and I therefore had to rescale them.
I should also point out that while there are a large number of trees, there are quite a few of them that are strikingly similar, and therefore it feels like there aren’t really that many variations.

description_text:
Moon landing module and moon landscape. Detailed terrain texture of 3k for the terrain and 4k for the landing module.
The spacecraft has 224806 polysThe terrain has 93280 polys
Apollo 11 was the spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon. Commander Neil Armstrong and lunar module pilot Buzz Aldrin formed the American crew that landed the Apollo Lunar Module Eagle on July 20, 1969, at 20:17 UTC. Armstrong became the first person to step onto the lunar surface six hours and 39 minutes later on July 21 at 02:56 UTC; Aldrin joined him 19 minutes later. They spent about two and a quarter hours together outside the spacecraft, and they collected 47.5 pounds (21.5 kg) of lunar material to bring back to Earth. Command module pilot Michael Collins flew the Command Module Columbia alone in lunar orbit while they were on the Moon's surface. Armstrong and Aldrin spent 21 hours, 36 minutes on the lunar surface at a site they named Tranquility Base before lifting off to rejoin Columbia in lunar orbit.

description_text:
Dimension: 9.7m (L) x 5.5m (W) x 4.3m (H)
The personal aricraft travels across continents in the clouds carrying capsule house and more like a daily vehicle which is different than the airship where it carries a numbers of capsule houses. this is a new edition to the Sci-fi 002 series. the personal aircraft is highly decorated on the exterior with minimal interior finishes. the model created in sketchup 2021 and rendered using enscape version 3.1. this 3d model is more likely inspired by the modular architecture concept that can add and subtract any units for peoples demand making it more sustainable and reusable for other purpose. the capsules attached are like blocks of rooms which represent single unit house.
the model can be use as prop, backdrop or anything that suits the futuristic environment as long as it fits with your needs!
*render is for illustration purpose only and the outcome may vary depending on the rendering engine , materials being use and lighting.

description_text:
Moon Crater 2
Optimized 3D Model of Moon Terrain ready for Cinematics, Animations, and Games. This asset is native to Blender and Unreal Engine 5. This asset is based on a 5000x5000 km area but can be scaled to fit your needs and is meant for medium to far shots.
This mesh is Optimized to only have more triangles where needed, while flatter areas contain less triangles.
This Asset Includes:
8K Textures (Color, Normal) 3 8K CC0 Textures (Rock Albedo, Rock Normal, Cracked Ground Roughness)
.Blend and .Uasset with custom materials to make the most use of the textures
.PDF FILE FAQ and Guide with more information and detail on the asset and how to use the accompanying textures and Materials.
This asset is made to be user friendly but also super customizable in terms of texturing.
Cover Images are rendered in Blender Cycles 4.0 and 2 Images in Unreal Engine 5.2.
NOTES:
Normals Are in DirectX Compatible with both Eevee and Cycles, If using custom Material Setup, some settings are labeled that need to be adjusted depending on the chosen render engine. Displacement Map can also be used to generate this terrain versus the provided optimized geometry mesh

description_text:
This collection contains models for 3D printing of some of Pittsburgh's tallest and most iconic buildings from the pre-War era. The 4 buildings included are (from left to right in the images) the Cathedral of Learning, Gulf Building, Grant Building, and Koppers Tower. The 4 buildings included in this pack are in the same scale (1:1000 by default, however it is recommended to scale this down to 75%, which would be 1333:1). Please note that the Cathedral of Learning and the Gulf Building may be purchased individually. 
The Cathedral of Learning stands 535ft (163m) tall far away from the dense city's dense downtown in the Oakland neighborhood. The building was designed by Charles Klauder and completed in 1936. The gothic style tower serves as a central building to the University of Pittsburgh. The Cathedral of Learning was the tallest educational building in the world at the time of its completion. Today, while several other buildings have risen higher (Moscow State University's main building and 2 skyscrapers in Tokyo), it remains the tallest educational building in the Western hemisphere. It is also the 2nd tallest gothic styled building in the world behind the Woolworth Building in New York City.
The Gulf Building is a 582ft (177m) tall skyscraper in the northern side of Pittsburgh's downtown. It was desined by Trowbridge & Livingston for the Gulf Oil Corporation. Completed in 1932, the art deco building was the tallest building in Pennsylvania for almost 40 years. The top of the building is colorfully lit up at night, with different colors and patterns symbolizing different weather forecasts. This soaring building was constructed on the site of the United States's first oil refinery.
The Grant Building is a 485ft (148m) skyscraper on the southwestern edge of downtown. It was designed by Henry Hornbostel in an art deco style and completed in 1929. For around 2 years, it stood as the tallest building in Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania. The building is famous for its radio antenna, which flashes in morse code to spell out the word P-I-T-T-S-B-U-R-G-H. In the 90 years since the tower was constructed, the obelisks that once adorned the building's rooflines have been removed. This model captures the original design of the architect with full ornamentation.
The Koppers Tower is 475ft (145m) tall and stands across the street from the Gulf Building. The building was comissioned by famous Pittsburgh businessman Andrew Mellon and designed by Chicago architecture firm Graham, Anderson, Probst & White. The art deco building was completed in 1929.
This collection contains an STL format file for each building as well as ZIP files containing 4 additional file formats (OBJ, 3DS, FBX, and DAE) for potential other uses. Please note these models were created solely for 3D printing, so they would likely require extensive reworking and texturing to be used in 3D modeling software for any other purposes.

description_text:
A set of 12 models, suitable for depicting under construction, unfinished, or abandoned buildings. All are primarially constucted from concrete. Scaffolding, barriers and and exposed rebar is included in some of the models to add detail. They use transparent textures.Tallest building is 138m, shortest is 39m. Footprints vary from around 25m on the shortest dimension and up to 70m on the largest. 
Geometry:

  - Geometry is highly mixed, mostly quads/tris. Not watertight. Faces intersect. For transparent materials, face backsides are visible.

  - Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres

  - 12 objects, 1 per building

Materials/textures:

  - A set of materials and textures are shared by all buildings. Total of 8 materials and 15 textures.

  - Color and normal maps only. Transparent images are used for fencing and scaffolding.

  - Dimensions range from 4k to 1k

  - png format, 32-bit RGBA.

  - Fully UV mapped with overlap

Created in Blender. A HDRI is included in the Blender file.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Street Sweeper vehicle.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
This way it is also good enough for close-ups. Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry. 
Technical details:

  - 4096 x 4096 Diffuse and AO textures for the main part. 

  - 1024 x 1024 Diffuse and AO textures for brush part.

  - 6164 Triangles

  - 3491 Polygons

  - 3640 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into parts to suit the animation process.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real-world, size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.glb)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

The model is a very low-poly, street dumpster asset, ideal for runtime rendering. It's using PBR textures (metallic workflow), maps are: Albedo, metallic, Gloss (in metallic's alpha channel), AO and normal map.
Texture resolution is 2048x2048, only lossless formats are used (.PNG and .TIFF, 8 bits/channel). The difference between the two dumpsters are the albedo channels only.

Should you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact me!

  - Rigging manually the front and rear bodies of the bus.

  - You may have to re-assign textures links and/or type (maybe changing) their names in the material editor.

  - Probably change some textures projection type from « UVW Mapping » to « Cubic »

  - You may have to adjust material details as transparency, luminance, reflectance…

description_text:
Trash Cans Garbage Beverage 24 Types - PBR AssetKit
A comprehensive kit of beverage cans / drink cans in multiple stages of wear and tear, multiple brands and two sizes.Have a look at the renderings and wireframes.This collection is built for 24 combinations, the UV layout is the same for all cans so you are free to vary colors and normal maps over all assets to get even more variance.Scatter them in your scenes or place them by hand, these assets are a great tool to add live and detail to scenes!
The textures are set up for easy customisation.Exchange a can layout in the base color texture with your own can layout and you are ready to render your own cans in minutes.On top of the damaged and grunge variants you will find clean textures in the package as well as undamaged can geometry.You have a full set of 4k textures and 1k textures in the package, I also included my PBR wet concrete material you see in the renderings.
All meshes are clean and ready for subdivision, on top a low poly variant with triangulation is included if you need very performant assets.
Meshes:

  - Can_Beverage_Undamaged 500ml - SubDiv

  - Can_Beverage_Undamaged - SubDiv

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_01 - SubDiv

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_02 - SubDiv

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_03 - SubDiv

  - Can_Beverage_Undamaged 500ml - Triangulated

  - Can_Beverage_Undamaged - Triangulated

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_01 - Triangulated

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_02 - Triangulated

  - Can_Beverage_Damaged_03 - Triangulated

Textures:All follwing textures come in 4k and 1k for each type of wear and tear + undamaged clean and undamaged grunge variants

  - Base Color A

  - Base Color B

  - Base Color C

  - Base Color D

  - Roughness

  - Metalness

  - Normal Clean (Only geometry and sculpt normals)

  - Normal DX

  - Normal GL

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Curvature

  - AO

Textures additional:

  - HDR Environment - The one from the renderings

  - Ground Wet Concrete Material - 2 Types, Dry + Wet (Color, Roughness, Normals)

Enjoy rendering!AssetKit
